services.desc: Hi! I’m the owner of Gemstone Gymnastics, along with my husband Chris. I want to tell you a little about myself and why I started this gym. It started out as my vision, but it was never about me. It was always about YOU, the gymnasts, the gym moms and dads, and the staff. I fell in love with gymnastics as a little girl, and by the time I saw the 1996 Olympics on TV I was hooked! Who remembers Kerri Strug and that famous one footed vault? I stayed in gymnastics or some form of it (cheerleading, dance) throughout my childhood. In college, I found gymnastics again, in a new form, as a coach. I started coaching at a club in Sacramento, my home town, that had a philosophy centered around caring
